candidates.title: Police locate vehicle allegedly used by Toronto mother to abduct 3 children
candidates.description: Toronto police say they have found a vehicle believed to have been used to abduct three children from Scarborough on Friday, but the children and their mother have not been found.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 'Crypto King' trial hears recording of Aiden Pleterski admitting $300M fund 'never existed'
candidates.description: Self-described "Crypto King" Aiden Pleterski admitted his $300-million fund never existed in a June 2022 audio recording played in court at his fraud trial in Toronto on Monday.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Horse-drawn carriages are still a tradition in some Canadian cities
candidates.description: The horse-drawn carriage industry is again getting a lot of neigh-sayers, after New York City council passed a bill last week that would ban the rides by June 2028.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Point May, N.L. residents rally for a whale-sized weekend rescue
candidates.description: Matt Lamkin says two pilot whales were stranded on the beach by his home and the community rallied to save them Sunday.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: A new cancer drug costs as much as a home down payment each month. Doctors say that's greed, not health care
candidates.description: Vancouver's James Howard is paying $90,000 a month for a new pancreatic cancer treatment that may add a few more months to his life. But, he's far from the only Canadian who is faced with having to find the means to access new cancer medicines at high costs and it's an issue that front-line oncologists across the country say is pushing public health care past a breaking point.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Montreal police officer who allegedly urinated on homeless people faces ethics probe
candidates.description: Guy Lapointe Jr., Quebec's new domestic security, said both the police ethics commissioner and the province's independent police watchdog, known as the BEI, will look into the allegations.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: WestJet signs code-share partnership deal with Qatar Airways
candidates.description: Under the agreement, WestJet will start by placing its airline code on Qatar Airways' non-stop flights to Doha from Toronto and Montreal.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: St. John's man with disability could become homeless after losing support program
candidates.description: When Raylynn White was told her cousin "graduated," she didn’t celebrate. The news, given over the phone, meant her beloved relative Michael Morrison no longer qualifies for the Community Support Program facilitated by Newfoundland and Labrador Health Services.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: N.S.' High Liner Foods to be bought by Japanese seafood giant in $804M deal
candidates.description: The companies say Umios plans to establish High Liner Foods as the core platform for its North American business, while maintaining its headquarters in Nova Scotia.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: IN PHOTOS | Toronto voters head to the polls in tight municipal race
candidates.description: Voters in Toronto are heading to the polls Monday to choose a mayor, councillors and school board trustees in province-wide municipal elections.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Federal Conservatives renew push to end B.C. North Coast tanker ban
candidates.description: Conservative Leader Pierre Poilievre has asked Prime Minister Mark Carney to repeal the oil tanker ban on British Columbia's northern coast months after Canada inked a deal not to change it.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Video of man helping homeless couple should inspire compassion and change, building manager says
candidates.description: A heartwarming video that shows a Londoner stopping to give warmth to a sleeping homeless couple offers an example of kindness and a stark reminder that institutions need to do better, a local man says.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: The Bank of Canada's inflation dilemma
candidates.description: Canada's economy is weak, but inflation is rising. The Bank of Canada has to choose which problem to take on. Raising interest rates will weaken the economy further while lowering rates would make inflation worse. The central bank decides what to do on Wednesday.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: First Nations want tangible results as 'historic' first ministers' meeting opens
candidates.description: First Nations leaders and Canada's first ministers will meet in Ottawa to discuss Indigenous rights for the first time in two decades, amid warnings and a planned protest against what the Assembly of First Nations is calling an "historic gathering."
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Air Canada blamed maintenance issues to deny compensation. Records show it wanted planes for other routes
candidates.description: Documents obtained by Go Public show Air Canada told passengers their flights were cancelled for safety-related aircraft maintenance, making them ineligible for compensation. But the planes they had been scheduled to fly on were fine and the airline used them for other routes.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Reports show staffing shortages, training lapses and care failures in N.L. group homes
candidates.description: Group homes and residential care placements ensure children without a home have somewhere to live, and ideally, to thrive. A CBC News investigation has found that's not always the case.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: There’s disappointment and hope among Albertans who supported the idea of independence
candidates.description: Now that the results of the referendum have come in, with three-quarters of Albertans voting to stay in Canada, we reached out to some residents who supported the other side to see how they feel and what they think happens next.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Halifax’s 'Pied Piper' J. Chalmers Doane becomes first Canadian in Ukulele Hall of Fame
candidates.description: Music educator J. Chalmers Doane, who transformed Canadian classrooms by introducing the ukulele into public schools, is making history as the first Canadian inducted into the Hawaii-based Ukulele Hall of Fame.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Lula re-elected in Brazil as Bolsonaro rejects results
candidates.description: Brazil's President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, a vocal critic of U.S. President Donald Trump, was re-elected Sunday in a result that provides relief to critics of widening U.S. influence in Latin America.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: UN commission says Israel has continued to commit genocide in Gaza since truce
candidates.description: A United Nations commission says Israel ​continued to commit genocide in Gaza after last October's U.S.-brokered ceasefire in the enclave, in a report published Monday that Israel dismissed as part of a "misinformation campaign."
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: U.S. officials accuse Canada of midterm meddling — but Trump has endorsed foreign candidates
candidates.description: Despite U.S. officials repeatedly warning Canada not to get involved in the upcoming U.S. midterms, U.S. President Donald Trump has his own track record of weighing in on foreign elections.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: How this Brooklyn bar owner had Conan O’Brien in stitches on SubwayTakes
candidates.description: Debbie Shields took a seat on a New York City subway and ended up joking with comedian Conan O'Brien about their fictional family. Their exchange on internet talk show SubwayTakes went viral. The Brooklyn bar owner says she's always making people laugh, but this experience was surreal.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Anthropic files for potentially biggest IPO ever, even as CEO warns of AI risks to humanity
candidates.description: Artificial intelligence giant Anthropic filed papers on Monday for what could be the biggest initial public offering of stock ever.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Nigeria Ebola patient flown to Switzerland, Congo health worker killed as 4 countries deal with outbreak
candidates.description: Officials on opposite sides of the African continent are trying to determine how a woman diagnosed with Ebola in Nigeria's capital last week contracted the deadly virus without having visited the Democratic Republic of Congo — the epicentre of one of the worst human outbreaks of the virus in history.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Microsoft gives voluntary buyout offer to about 60,000 employees
candidates.description: Microsoft said on Monday it is offering voluntary buyouts to more than a quarter of its global workforce — including in Canada — as the technology giant looks to contain costs and help fund its ‌massive AI investments.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Jordan arrests 3 suspects in deadly church attack after gunbattle
candidates.description: Jordanian security forces arrested two brothers and their brother-in-law after a shootout on Monday over a church attack that ​killed nine people, and the suspects appear to have no ​ties to other terrorist cells, senior government security officials said.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Netanyahu 'fighting for his political life' in 1st Israeli vote since Oct. 7. He might still survive

candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Israeli military conducts massive West Bank operation, days before Israel election

candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Serbia's longtime strongman Vučić concedes election defeat to student-led opposition
candidates.description: Serbia's Aleksandar Vučić conceded defeat to a student-led protest movement in a historic election on Sunday that ends his long grip on power ​and heralds a new political era in the ​Balkan country.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Ukraine says its military did not violate Starlink terms, disputing Elon Musk claim
candidates.description: Ukrainian officials have disputed claims by SpaceX CEO Elon Musk that the country's military violated Starlink's terms of service by using the civilian satellite internet network for offensive drone strikes. Serhii Beskrestnov, a defence technology adviser to President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, said long-standing restrictions on the civilian system in Ukraine made such offensive use impossible.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Venezuela's opposition leader Machado returns after months in exile
candidates.description: Opposition leader and Nobel laureate María Corina Machado reappeared in Venezuela Sunday for the first time since December, about a month before the U.S. military deposed the country's then-President Nicolás Maduro.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Carney's geopolitical ambitions tested in defence industry co-operation with Turkey

candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Tennessee may try to execute Christa Pike again. The state could face legal hurdles

But the state could face some constitutional hurdles if it plans to try again, some legal experts say.

candidates.title: 'They’re the nicest people': Obama mocks Trump for hitting Canada with tariffs

candidates.title: Why Israel's election is one of the most important in its history
